title: 冰磚來了
subject: a zookeeper in a thirty-seven-degree July heatwave wheeling out frozen blocks of watermelon, apples and a whole chicken for the sun bear, the orangutans and the tiger, while sweating visitors fan themselves with zoo maps and an old man in a straw hat asks to buy one
caption: Mandarin baile funk in the Rio de Janeiro party style. A booming tamborzão drum-machine groove with syncopated kicks and dry snare cracks, a referee whistle blasting on the downbeats, distorted 808 bass stabs, a short brass-stab loop, and a cuíca squeaking between phrases. Raw, loud, compressed party mix with the vocal dry and up front. Male voice, a cheeky mid-range MC, half-rapped and chanted, with a crowd shouting the answers in call-and-response. 130 BPM, G minor. Sweaty, cheeky and loud. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no reggaeton dembow, no EDM drop, no drift-phonk cowbell, no samba batucada.
lyrics:
[Intro - whistle blasts and tamborzão drums]

[Verse 1]
七月下午兩點 三十七度
遊客拿園區地圖 拼命搧風
我推著推車 白煙一直冒
西瓜 蘋果 香蕉 凍成一大塊一大塊

[Pre-Chorus]
馬來熊看到我 馬上站起來
紅毛猩猩 早就蹲在門口等

[Chorus - MC and Crowd Call-and-Response]
冰磚來了 冰磚來了
要不要 要 要不要 要
一隻一塊 不要搶
熊抱著西瓜冰 舔到眼睛都瞇起來

[Verse 2]
老虎那塊不一樣 裡面包一整隻雞
牠用前腳 推到水池邊
推下去 自己也跟著跳下去
玻璃外面的人說 我也想泡

[Chorus - MC and Crowd Call-and-Response]
冰磚來了 冰磚來了
要不要 要 要不要 要
有個阿伯戴斗笠 問我一塊賣多少
阿伯 這是給熊吃的 不能賣

[Bridge - whistle and drums only]
下班前 推車裡還剩一塊
什麼都沒包 就是一塊冰

[Chorus - MC and Crowd Call-and-Response]
冰磚來了 最後這塊是我的
要不要 要 這塊不給
我把它貼在脖子後面
熊隔著鐵欄杆看我 我們兩個都不想動

[Outro - whistle and drums fading]
